Chapter 660: Chapter 6: River Of Time (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 660: Chapter 6: River of Time (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

“Ancient Power Supreme Being?” Lin Yuan, although he had not seen this supreme being of human civilization with his own eyes, had a strong feeling that the other party was the Ancient Power Supreme Being.

And this tall and sturdy figure seemed to sense Lin Yuan’s gaze, lowered his head to meet his eyes, and vaguely revealed benevolence.

Lin Yuan continued to look into the distance.

One by one, the towering figures of the supreme beings of human civilization appeared.

Feather Butterfly Supreme Being, Void God Supreme Being, and so on.

All the supreme beings standing on the banks of the River of Time were immensely towering.

...

Soon.

Lin Yuan spotted the tenth supreme being.

This supreme being was not one of human civilization’s; shrouded in a dark mist, Lin Yuan had merely glanced at him momentarily before being noticed by the individual.

“Hmph!”

A faint snort came, causing Lin Yuan’s expression to slightly change, and at that moment, Xia Qin Supreme Being, who was standing beside and shielding Lin Yuan, raised his right hand, causing the snort to completely disappear.

“That supreme being harbors great malice towards me.”

Lin Yuan dared not continue watching and could only look elsewhere as much as possible.

…

The towering figure shrouded in dark mist stood on the banks of the River of Time, coldly watching Xia Qin Supreme Being in the distance.

“At any cost, taking an ant who hasn’t even grasped the Rule of Time out of the River of Time is utterly foolish.” The towering figure silently thought to himself.

The cost required for such actions was terrifying.

Almost every moment was comparable to the cosmic backlash endured from resurrecting dozens of Eleventh Rank powerhouses.

Xia Qin Supreme Being did this, risking a considerable period in the future where he might not be able to maintain his peak combat power.

“Human civilization…” The towering figure’s thoughts fluctuated.

The rise of human civilization was the fastest among all the peak clans.

The main reason was the unity among its people, who, even as supreme beings, would not hesitate to pay a price to help talented juniors within their clan.

To other supreme beings, this was utterly inconceivable. To let a supreme being itself pay a price for a mere life below the ultimate?

Is it worth it?

For most supreme beings, the clans are merely vassals; the individual supreme beings are everything.

…

Lin Yuan’s fragment of spirit will continued to look into the distance.

He saw more towering figures symbolizing supreme beings.

Some of these towering figures were indifferent to Lin Yuan’s gaze, some showed benevolence, and more displayed dissatisfaction, all of which were blocked by Xia Qin Supreme Being.

As he continued to observe, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Rule of Time was improving at a terrifying rate; this place was the River of Time, where the Rule of Time was most directly observable.

Normally, any life qualified to overlook the River of Time would have already mastered the Rule of Time. Those not qualified to step out of the River of Time could not comprehend the Rule of Time.

But with Xia Qin Supreme Being’s help, Lin Yuan had broken this ironclad rule.

Time slowly passed.

For how long, he did not know.

“It’s about time for you to go back.”

Xia Qin Supreme Being’s words sounded, and Lin Yuan felt this fragment of his spirit will rapidly begin to fade.

…

“Eh?”

On the Milky Way Main Star, Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes.

“Am I back?”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his mood uneasy for a long time.

Who could have thought that he had just overlooked the entire flow of the River of Time? As a Ninth Rank life, breaking free from the constraints of the River of Time, even if only briefly, that too was an unprecedented great opportunity.

“I even saw the true bodies of many supreme beings?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself; he had always been unclear about what supreme beings truly were? Even if there were images of supreme beings fighting each other on large-scale battlefields.

Lin Yuan was still baffled and unable to comprehend, the gambits between supreme beings involved levels too high, without reaching that height, one couldn’t even make sense of what they were watching.

“Xia Qin Supreme Being finally told me to come back, his voice seemed somewhat weak?” Lin Yuan did not know how much had been paid by the supreme being to take him out of the River of Time.

But just from the tone, carrying hints of much, he knew that the price paid was absolutely not small.

“I wonder if I could step into being a supreme being…” Lin Yuan reminisced about that feeling of breaking free from the River of Time, a sense of unprecedented freedom.

Even with Lin Yuan’s many foundations, it was still not guaranteed that he could become a supreme being.

Even mastering the legendary Chaos Rules would only be greatly beneficial to turning into a supreme being.

Whether or not he could finally step into it, was another matter altogether.

The birth of each supreme being was not an inevitability.

“My current understanding of the Rule of Time…” Lin Yuan carefully felt the changes within himself.

Having gone to the banks of the River of Time, Lin Yuan gained a whole new understanding of the Rule of Time, a view starkly different from the past, only possible for those who had personally observed the entirety of the River of Time.

“Time…”

“It’s wonderful…”

Lin Yuan stretched out his hands, and strands of Time Fluctuation seemed to be stirred up, forming slight ripples of time.

“I am now not too far from mastering the Rule of Time,” Lin Yuan breathed out softly, thinking to himself.

Logically speaking, before mastering the Rule of Time, no Evolver dared claim with certainty they could comprehend the Rule of Time.

Because the Rule of Time is so vast, without reaching that step, no one would be sure if they could master it.
